te: Pre-meeting video · Holistic security: business, tax, land and financial agencies invited on matters concerning foreign nationals, and the 2026 performance report
Holistic security: agencies invited to clarify matters on foreign nationals that may affect security
se: Meeting on Thursday, 12 November 2026, at 09.00, Meeting Rooms 406–407, Floor 4, Parliament House. According to the meeting notice, the main item is holistic security management regarding the entry of foreign nationals in ways that may affect security and public order, with agencies such as the Office of the National Security Council, the National Intelligence Agency, the Immigration Bureau and the Department of Special Investigation invited to clarify. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it
it: Entry of foreign nationals in ways that may affect security (the NSC, NIA, AFSC, Special Branch Bureau, Immigration Bureau, Provincial Police Regions 8 and 9, and DSI were invited to clarify)
Report on travel readiness and the subcommittees' work

te: Pre-meeting video · Holistic security: agencies invited to clarify matters on foreign nationals that may affect security
Petitions, preparing to meet the Chief of Defence Forces, and following up the subcommittees' work
se: Meeting on Thursday, 5 November 2026, at 09.30, Room CA 327, Floor 3, Parliament House. According to the meeting notice, the main items are complaints and proposals sent to the Committee, the schedule for a courtesy discussion with the Chief of Defence Forces and senior commanders at the Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters, and following up the subcommittees’ work. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it
it: Petitions, requests for consideration and proposals sent to the committee
Schedule for a study visit and official discussions with the Chief of Defence Forces at Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters
Follow-up of the subcommittees' work

te: Following up on the Singkhon border checkpoint, Prachuap Khiri Khan, from a security perspective, and preparing to meet the Chief of Defence Forces
se: The meeting invited agencies such as the Office of the National Security Council, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Interior, the Royal Thai Survey Department, Prachuap Khiri Khan Province, the customs checkpoint and local task forces to provide information on the status and conditions of the Singkhon checkpoint from a security perspective; took note of the Committee’s complaint statistics; approved the report on deploying reserve personnel; and approved courtesy discussions with the British Ambassador to Thailand and the Chief of Defence Forces
it: Status and conditions of the Singkhon checkpoint, Prachuap Khiri Khan Province, from a security perspective (security, foreign affairs, interior and provincial agencies were invited to provide information)
Statistics of petitions and grievances received by the committee
Subcommittees: report on the framework for deploying reserve personnel, results of the National Space Exhibition visit, and inviting agencies to clarify border security
Official discussions with the British Ambassador to Thailand and the Chief of Defence Forces (19 November 2026)
10 honorary advisers to the committee appointed

te: Meeting summary video · Following up on the Singkhon border checkpoint, Prachuap Khiri Khan, from a security perspective, and preparing to meet the Chief of Defence Forces
Work report for 2026, proposals to restore the southern border area, and the Navy's frigate procurement
se: The meeting took note of the Cabinet’s actions on the study report on military use of attack drones, considered proposals for recovery and relief for people affected in the southern border provinces, took note of the draft annual performance report for fiscal year 2026, followed up the subcommittees’ work (such as the need for and approach to the Royal Thai Navy’s frigate acquisition), and approved a study visit on recovery and relief in the southern border provinces on 30–31 October 2026
it: Cabinet action on the study report on the military use of attack drones
Proposals for recovery, relief and building peace for people affected by the unrest in the southern border provinces
Draft report on the committee's work, fiscal year 2026
Subcommittees: a visit to Lop Buri Province, the Royal Thai Navy’s approach to acquiring frigates, the National Space Exhibition, and the security situation along the border
Study visit on recovery, relief and easing the effects in the southern border provinces, 30–31 October 2026
19 honorary advisers to the committee appointed

te: Meeting summary video · Work report for 2026, proposals to restore the southern border area, and the Navy's frigate procurement
Start of fiscal year 2027: recovery and relief for people affected in the southern border provinces, subcommittee reports, and results of study visits to 3 sites
se: The meeting took note of the status of upgrading relaxed trade points from the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Interior and the 2027 budget approach for standing committees, considered a complaint about domestic firearms manufacturing (deferred for now), took note of proposed approaches to recovery and relief for people affected by the unrest in the southern border provinces, and approved the subcommittees’ reports (such as on the Internal Security Act and the results of the defence industry seminar) and the reports of study visits to the Volunteer Defence Corps Headquarters, Prachuap Khiri Khan–Phetchaburi and Nakhon Nayok
it: Readiness to upgrade relaxed trade points (letter from the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Interior)
A petition on domestic firearms manufacturing and improving the related laws
Proposals for recovery, relief and building peace for people affected by the unrest in the southern border provinces
Subcommittees: military court proceedings, results of the defence industry seminar, a report on the Internal Security Act, and appointment of advisers
Study visit reports: Volunteer Defence Corps Headquarters (Bangkok), Prachuap Khiri Khan–Phetchaburi and Nakhon Nayok Provinces
Help for flood victims, and summary of activities for fiscal year 2026

te: Meeting summary video · Start of fiscal year 2027: recovery and relief for people affected in the southern border provinces, subcommittee reports, and results of study visits to 3 sites
Third vice-chair, internal security visit to Nakhon Nayok, and discussion of foreign nationals who may affect security
se: The meeting approved Mrs. Varapas Phaiphannarat as Third Vice-Chair of the Committee, approved a study visit on local internal security in Nakhon Nayok Province, took note of the subcommittees’ progress reports, and discussed a special agenda item on the entry of foreign nationals in ways that may affect security
it: Mrs. Varapas Phaiphannarat becomes Third Vice-Chair of the committee
Study visit on local internal security in Nakhon Nayok Province
Performance reports of all 3 subcommittees (Military Affairs · Cyber, Technology, Weapons and Defence Industry · Holistic Security)
Entry of foreign nationals in ways that may affect security (special item)

te: Speeding up the study report to the Senate, and setting rules for appointing honorary advisers for 2027
se: The meeting considered ways to speed up presenting reports to the Senate, namely the annual performance report 2026 and the study reports of all 3 subcommittees (such as developing the armed forces’ personnel and the Internal Security Act), approved a draft announcement on the criteria for appointing honorary advisers, made appointments to Committee posts for fiscal year 2027, and took note of the outcome of one complaint
it: Ways to speed up submitting reports to the Senate: the annual performance report 2026 and the study reports of 3 subcommittees
Draft announcement on criteria for appointing honorary advisers, and appointments to committee posts for fiscal year 2027
Outcome of petitions sent to the committee

te: Draft Military Court Constitution law, a motion on the defence industry, and foreign nationals who may affect security
se: The meeting took note that the Ministry of Defence has proposed the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... to the National Assembly, resolved that Mr. Chaiyong Maneerungskul, the Committee Spokesperson, propose a motion in the Senate based on the Defence Industry Association’s proposals, set up a working group to consider proposals from residents of the lower South, and agreed that the Committee should study the entry of foreign nationals in ways that may affect security
it: Draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... proposed by the Ministry of Defence to the National Assembly, and the draft report of the subcommittee
Proposals of the Defence Industry Association
Public views from the Senate Meets the People project, lower southern group
Entry of foreign nationals in ways that may affect security and public order
Seminar “Upgrading Thailand's defence industry”, 8 September 2026, and summary of the internal security forum

te: Replies from government agencies, and the unrest in the southern border provinces
se: The meeting took note of letters to the Committee Chair from the Office of the Permanent Secretary to the Prime Minister, Provincial Police Region 2 and the Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters, adjusted the schedule of the study visit on new forms of security threats, took note of the subcommittees’ work, and considered the violent incidents in the southern border provinces affecting the safety of people’s lives and property
it: Letters from the Office of the Secretary-General to the Prime Minister, Provincial Police Region 2 and Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters
Study visit on addressing new forms of security threats
The situation of violence and unrest in the southern border provinces
Subcommittees on cyber affairs and on holistic security

te: Proposals on domestically built frigates, a palm plantation concession in Chumphon, and an internal security study visit
se: The meeting took note of information on the use of a concession oil palm plantation area affecting security and natural resources in Chumphon Province, closed the matter of encroachment on state land in military areas and referred it to the committees and agencies concerned, assigned the Cyber Subcommittee to consider a shipbuilding association’s proposals on promoting frigate construction in Thailand, and considered an internal security study visit
it: Use of an oil palm plantation concession area that affects security and natural resources, Chumphon Province
Encroachment on state land and damage to resources in military areas (continued)
Proposals to promote building frigates in Thailand and a shipbuilding industry strategy (from shipbuilding associations)
Study visit on maintaining public order and new forms of security threats
Subcommittees: the seminar “Upgrading Thailand's defence industry” and study visits

te: Draft summary and approach to Ranong–Chumphon border security approved, and proposals on the 2027 defence budget
se: The meeting approved the draft summary and approach for maintaining security along the Ranong and Chumphon border with Myanmar, took note of the recommendations given to the Ministry of Defence on the draft Annual Appropriations Act for fiscal year B.E. 2570, and took note of the work schedule of the Committee and subcommittees for August
it: Draft summary and approach to border security in Ranong and Chumphon Provinces
Recommendations to the Ministry of Defence on the draft Annual Appropriations Act for fiscal year B.E. 2570
Subcommittees: Parliament TV programme, and persons appointed to vacant positions
3 honorary advisers to the committee appointed
